## Usage statistics

Settings > Statistics now records characters seen, app session time, connected time, souls observed, distinct pets leveled, tracked rank-ups, pets maxed and app launches.

Counters save automatically and survive updates and game-progress resets. Estimated pet levels, login baselines and duplicate pickup events do not inflate achievements. Time tracking continues in the background and excludes PC sleep on Windows.

Copy a counts-only summary for sharing, or export cumulative reporting JSON for the future site. Reports use an installation ID and hashed character identities to support deduplication. A reporting service is not connected yet; statistics currently remain local. Tracking starts with this version and does not reconstruct past farming.
